ruleDefinitions.name: PUA- IOX Tunneling Tool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of IOX - a tool for port forwarding and intranet proxy purposes

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\iox\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ fwd\\ \\-l\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ fwd\\ \\-r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ proxy\\ \\-l\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ proxy\\ \\-r\\ .*")) OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=9DB2D314DD3F704A02051EF5EA210993.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=039130337E28A6623ECF9A0A3DA7D92C5964D8DD.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=C6CF82919B809967D9D90EA73772A8AA1C1EB3BC59252D977500F64F1A0D6731.*")))
